example.name: bug_report_to_issue_and_fix
example.scenario: User reports a bug: "App crashes when opening settings without internet."

step.description: Analyze and copyedit prompt into structured GitHub issue format
Extract repo owner and repo name from `git config --get remote.origin.url`
Search existing issues for duplicates; none found
Present drafted issue to user and get approval
Create issue on GitHub via MCP tool (`create_issue`), receiving issue #123
Create branch `issue-123`, hand off fix task to Orchestrator/Code mode
Upon return, verify fix against acceptance criteria, commit with message `Fix settings crash when offline (Fixes #123)`, push, and close issue #123

example.completion: Successfully created GitHub issue #123, implemented the fix, verified tests, committed with reference, and closed the issue.
